summary.intent: Autonomously run the full post-execute-phase ship pipeline for GSD Phase 68 (cipher-box): verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit → ship → resolve PR reviews, triaging findings without stopping to ask.
summary.outcome: Completed verify (accepted existing PASS), secure-phase, and validate-phase (0 gaps, VALIDATION.md updated) audits; the simplify pass found and fixed a real zeroization-order bug in client.ts (with a new red-green regression test) plus removed dead code in two web files; the SDK E2E gate required rebuilding a stale tee-worker container before going green; a pre-existing, CI-unreachable test failure and two other issues were captured as deferred todos rather than fixed; work was committed in three logical commits, but the transcript ends before CodeRabbit review, PR shipping, and PR-review resolution (steps 6-11) were reached.

repo: cipher-box's SDK E2E gate depends on a locally-running tee-worker container that can silently run stale code — a test failure there required rebuilding and restarting tee-worker from current source before the suite passed.
apps/web's vitest suite (including ipns.service.test) is not invoked anywhere in ci.yml, so failures there don't block CI — confirmed by mapping all CI job test commands.

Conventional-commit subject rule on this repo only forbids parens in the description part; scoped prefixes like 'feat(68-03):' are valid, so the filter-branch reword step can be a no-op if commits already use that form.
GSD's git log for this branch (86 commits) was already fully conventional-commit compliant, avoiding the need for git filter-branch history rewriting on this phase.

code.finding: moveItem's enumerateMoveDescendants had a zeroization-order bug; fixed and covered by a new regression test (packages/sdk/src/__tests__/client-move-enumerate.test.ts) verified to fail against the unfixed code and pass after the fix.

Dead code (ensureFreshSentShares and related scaffolding) had zero external importers — only stale comments referenced it — and was removed; retiring the rest was deferred as a todo (2026-07-02-retire-dead-sdk-share-scaffolding.md).
Contained unused code removed alongside the share.service.ts cleanup as part of the simplify pass.

workflow: When a failing test's structure matches main exactly, swap in main's version of the suspect dependency file and re-run to decisively prove whether the failure is pre-existing vs. introduced by the branch, rather than continuing to diff code by eye.

Before spending more time debugging a failing local test, check whether CI actually invokes that test file at all — if it's unreachable from CI, defer it as a todo instead of blocking the pipeline on it.

Running the security-audit agent, the simplify-review agent, and the client-chain build as parallel background jobs while continuing to check PR/gh state kept the pipeline moving without idle waiting.

friction: SDK E2E suite exit code 0 masked a stale tee-worker image; had to trace through republish queue/redis state and container logs before realizing the container needed a rebuild from current source.

ipns.service.test failure investigation was a long dead-end: same import/mock structure as main yet failing, requiring a decisive experiment (swapping in main's file) before concluding it was pre-existing and CI-unreachable rather than something to fix.

Had to independently re-verify the retroactive Nyquist validation (re-running SDK/API unit suites, locating PATCH grant test coverage) since VALIDATION.md only reflected planning-time strategy, not actual post-hoc audit.
